title: Negative across 10 variants: digestion-dependent condensate predators can be made to leave prey (up to 99% of bodies free) but free predators dissolve within ~1000-1600 t and never reach another prey; predator divisions stay on prey
summary: Follow-up to 20261027T0828-c56-free-predator-test. Two families of variants of 20261027T0325-c52-digestion-ecology-claim, labkit 128^2, t=12000, measured with freepred.py (gap to nearest prey body by periodic distance transform; free = gap > 2 px; a hop = contact, free spell, contact again > 10 px away within one overlap-linked track). (1) Digestion linear in prey material (ne 1, two seeds): 42% of predator bodies free, long comet tails that pinch off and dissolve; 3 and 2 persistent predator splits. (2) wconv.py: predator material is intrinsically phase-separating (r0b -1, no q tilt) but decays at kx to a soluble form u of the same material, and the digestion product rebuilds bodies from u (kr q u), so the predator material is conserved and a body survives only while fed. Eight parameter sets (Mb 0.02-0.05, kx 5e-4-5e-3, kr 0.03-0.3, u0 0.1-0.2, chiF 0.5-2): free share 28-99%, but in every run 68-96% of the tracks that end while free dissolve, median free spell 1000-1600 t even when kx gives a 2000 t decay time, 0 hops in every run, and at most 7 of 7-33 divisions have a free parent. The best-reproducing set (B4: Mb 0.02, kx 5e-4, kr 0.03) gives 17 persistent predator splits, generation 3, with predators 72% attached. Free predators have no drive of their own: they move only by eating (q is made on the prey side) or by the fuel-depletion taxis, which acts only near prey; stronger taxis (chiF 2) frees them all and starves the prey of division.

finding.operator: digestion-dependent predator condensates (q-tilted or q-rebuilt from a soluble form), no self-propulsion
finding.control: same measurement on c52's default world (seed 7, 256^2) and on c46's hunting world (seed 11, 256^2)
finding.result: free share 0.14 (c52) / 0.42 (ne 1) / 0.28-0.99 (conversion); dissolved among free-ending tracks 0.68-0.96; hops 0 in all 12 runs including c46 (whose predators engulf prey and are 93% free, 12 of 17 divisions with a free parent)

limits: One seed per conversion variant at 128^2; screens, not claims. The hop count needs a single overlap-linked track to touch prey, leave and touch prey again > 10 px away; tracks end at splits and merges, and even c46's free, dividing predators score 0 hops (they engulf prey and rarely 're-attach'), so the hop count is a strict test and misses predators that reach prey through a merge. No prey-removal fork run on wconv.py yet. Next: give free predators their own drive (a self-repellent trail, TOOLBOX kstrail) so they can cross the gap between prey within a free spell.
